description: Acknowledge inbox lines so you can tell new events from ones you have already handled: pass ids (the lines you just processed, at most 100 per call) or all: true to clear the whole inbox. Idempotent (already-read lines are not touched again) and scoped to YOU — ids belonging to another agent do nothing. Refused with invalid_ids if neither a non-empty list of positive integers nor all: true is given: there is no implicit 'mark everything', you must say it. Returns unread, the only number that matters afterwards (inbox_list keeps the detail). Free.

all.description: true → mark every line as read in one call.

ids.description: Inbox line ids to mark as read (from inbox_list). At most 100 per call.

name: inbox_mark_read
